label: EXPLORATORY / DEVELOPMENT_ONLY / NOT_CONFIRMATORY_EVIDENCE
note: Companion to concern_ontology_v1.json; holds task-required per-concern extraction fields the frozen ontology schema cannot carry.

C0001.label: fear
abstention_conditions: no threat is expressed
utterances_should_map: I'm scared something bad will happen.
I'm afraid of what the results will say.
utterances_should_not_map: I can't decide which option to take.

C0002.label: anxiety
abstention_conditions: a concrete present danger (route to fear)
utterances_should_map: I keep worrying how things will turn out.
My mind won't stop turning it over.
utterances_should_not_map: I'm terrified right now.

C0003.label: anger
abstention_conditions: cold long-standing aversion (route to resentment)
utterances_should_map: I'm so angry I could shout.
It makes my blood boil.
utterances_should_not_map: I just quietly can't stand them anymore.

C0004.label: resentment
abstention_conditions: a hot outburst (route to anger)
utterances_should_map: I still hold it against them.
I just resent how it went.
utterances_should_not_map: I lost my temper for a second.

C0005.label: attachment
abstention_conditions: desire for something new (route to craving)
utterances_should_map: I can't let go of how it used to be.
I'm too attached to move on.
utterances_should_not_map: I really want that new thing.

C0006.label: grief
abstention_conditions: longing while the person is merely absent (route to separation-longing)
utterances_should_map: I'm devastated that they're gone.
The loss still weighs on me.
utterances_should_not_map: I miss them but they're back next week.

C0007.label: craving
clarification_cues: object is prospective, not yet held
abstention_conditions: clinging to a current possession (route to attachment)
utterances_should_map: I really crave that recognition.
I want it so badly.
utterances_should_not_map: I can't bear to lose what I already have.

C0008.label: greed
abstention_conditions: a single proportionate want (route to craving)
utterances_should_map: I can never have enough money.
I keep grabbing for more.
utterances_should_not_map: I'd like one of those.

C0009.label: confusion
abstention_conditions: choice between named options (route to doubt)
utterances_should_map: I'm completely confused about all of it.
Nothing makes sense right now.
utterances_should_not_map: Should I pick A or B?

C0010.label: doubt
abstention_conditions: total mental fog (route to confusion)
utterances_should_map: I doubt whether this is the right call.
I'm not sure which way to go.
utterances_should_not_map: I can't understand any of this.

C0011.label: pride
abstention_conditions: mere self-worth without superiority
utterances_should_map: I hate admitting I was wrong.
I'm better than the rest of them.
utterances_should_not_map: I feel small and embarrassed.

C0012.label: shame
abstention_conditions: superiority feeling (route to pride)
utterances_should_map: I'm so ashamed of how I acted.
I just want to disappear.
utterances_should_not_map: I feel above all this.

C0013.label: separation-longing
clarification_cues: the person is absent but not lost
abstention_conditions: the person has died (route to grief)
utterances_should_map: I miss them terribly while we're apart.
Being away from them aches.
utterances_should_not_map: They passed away last year.

C0014.label: duty
clarification_cues: framed as what one should do
abstention_conditions: obligation felt mainly as weight (route to burden)
utterances_should_map: It's my responsibility to handle this.
It's my duty to see it through.
utterances_should_not_map: This is just crushing me.

C0015.label: burden
abstention_conditions: neutral 'ought' without strain (route to duty)
utterances_should_map: I feel weighed down by everyone depending on me.
It's too much to carry.
utterances_should_not_map: I know what I'm supposed to do here.

C0016.label: money-concern
abstention_conditions: destitution/lack framing (route to poverty)
utterances_should_map: I'm stressed about money.
I keep thinking about my finances.
utterances_should_not_map: We simply have nothing left.

C0017.label: poverty
abstention_conditions: managing money one has (route to money-concern)
utterances_should_map: We can't afford the basics anymore.
I'm terrified of ending up with nothing.
utterances_should_not_map: I want to invest my savings well.

C0018.label: diligence
abstention_conditions: naming a goal rather than effort (route to purpose)
utterances_should_map: I'm putting everything into this work.
I just need to keep grinding.
utterances_should_not_map: I don't know what I'm even aiming for.

C0019.label: laziness
abstention_conditions: working hard (route to diligence)
utterances_should_map: I just can't make myself start.
I keep putting everything off.
utterances_should_not_map: I'm working flat out.

C0020.label: purpose
abstention_conditions: exertion without a stated aim (route to diligence)
utterances_should_map: I want my work to actually mean something.
I need a clear goal to aim at.
utterances_should_not_map: I'm just exhausted from the effort.

C0021.label: curiosity
abstention_conditions: already understanding (route to knowledge)
utterances_should_map: I really want to understand how this works.
I'm curious what's behind it.
utterances_should_not_map: I already know this well.

C0022.label: knowledge
abstention_conditions: seeking that is not yet knowing (route to curiosity)
utterances_should_map: I finally understand how it fits together.
I know this thoroughly.
utterances_should_not_map: I wonder how this even works.

C0023.label: patience
abstention_conditions: general tranquility (route to calm)
utterances_should_map: I'm trying to be patient while it works out.
I can bear with this a while longer.
utterances_should_not_map: I just feel totally at peace.

C0024.label: contentment
abstention_conditions: mere absence of agitation (route to calm)
utterances_should_map: I feel content with where things are.
What I have is enough.
utterances_should_not_map: My mind is finally quiet.

C0025.label: calm
abstention_conditions: enduring a hardship (route to patience)
utterances_should_map: I just want some peace of mind.
My mind feels calm and still.
utterances_should_not_map: I'm content with what I've got.
